mechanism_inventory: access-control mismatch — onlyTSS depends on TSSAddress being set correctly; compromised or rotated TSS is the real risk vector
missing invariant enforcement — withdraw does not check paused state; a paused contract can still have withdraw called by TSS, draining funds while deposits are locked
missing paused-state check in withdraw — deposit enforces paused revert but withdraw has no such guard
value exceeds a logical/economic bound — withdraw sends arbitrary amount with no cap/ledger (ERC20 balance is the only floor)
wrong lifecycle ordering — asymmetric pause where depositors are locked out while TSS can drain
external-call failure / DoS — safeTransfer to recipient; reverting recipient bricks that withdrawal
stale accounting snapshot — deposit uses balance-delta for fee-on-transfer; withdraw sends raw amount, creating accounting mismatch with the cross-chain ledger
authorization path — TSSAddressUpdater can rotate TSSAddress; compromised updater drains all custodied funds

selected_mechanisms.root_cause: withdraw does not check the paused state, while deposit does. When paused=true, deposits are blocked but TSS can still withdraw, creating an asymmetric invariant: the contract is half-paused.
selected_mechanisms.attacker_model: TSS address (privileged). The mechanism is about invariant correctness: the pause mechanism does not achieve its stated bilateral freeze.
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: 1. TSS calls pause(). 2. Users' deposit() revert IsPaused(). 3. TSS calls withdraw() — no paused check, safeTransfer drains funds. 4. Incoming frozen, outgoing not.
selected_mechanisms.who_loses: Depositors whose funds can be withdrawn while they are locked out; protocol pause guarantee violated.
selected_mechanisms.who_gains: TSS (or compromised TSS) can drain under cover of a paused state.
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: Distinct mechanism (missing invariant enforcement on a different state variable, paused). Real victim class. Even if TSS trusted, documented pause behavior is incorrect — Medium or above.

selected_mechanisms.root_cause: For fee-on-transfer tokens, deposit() accounts via balance-delta (emits real received amount) but withdraw() uses the raw amount parameter — no fee-on-transfer accounting. Cross-chain ledger diverges from EVM custody reality.
selected_mechanisms.attacker_model: Protocol accounting mismatch for fee-on-transfer tokens (not external attacker per se).
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: 1. deposit fee-on-transfer token; emitted = received (less than requested). 2. ZetaChain credits received. 3. TSS withdraw(amount=received); safeTransfer deducts fee again; recipient gets less than credited. Accounting broken.
selected_mechanisms.who_loses: Users bridging fee-on-transfer tokens receive less than credited, or withdrawals fail.
selected_mechanisms.who_gains: No direct attacker gain — accounting integrity violation harming users.
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: Different variable (emitted Withdrawn vs actual transferred) and token class than pause. Source: deposit uses balance-delta, withdraw does not.

unresolved_mechanisms.mechanism: TSSAddressUpdater compromise enabling TSS rotation to attacker address and drain
unresolved_mechanisms.source_evidence: updateTSSAddress() callable by TSSAddressUpdater with no timelock/multisig. Once rotated, new TSSAddress has full withdraw() access.
unresolved_mechanisms.unresolved_question: Whether TSSAddressUpdater is protected by external multisig/governance — not in source.

rejected_mechanisms.mechanism: access-control bypass — unprivileged caller reaching withdraw
rejected_mechanisms.rejecting_source_fact: onlyTSS reverts InvalidSender if msg.sender != TSSAddress; set at construction, updated only by TSSAddressUpdater.
rejected_mechanisms.why_unexploitable: No unprivileged caller can satisfy msg.sender == TSSAddress.

rejected_mechanisms.mechanism: reentrancy via safeTransfer callback in withdraw
rejected_mechanisms.rejecting_source_fact: withdraw() carries nonReentrant; reentrant calls revert.

impact_direction.attacker_receives: TSS (or compromised TSS) can withdraw during paused state; fee-on-transfer accounting divergence causes users to receive less than credited.
impact_direction.attacker_preserves: TSS ability to drain even under pause.
impact_direction.victim_loses: Depositors lose funds or receive less than credited; pause invariant protecting depositors violated.
impact_direction.invariant_violated: Pause should freeze custody bilaterally; withdraw not guarded by paused. Cross-chain accounting invariant violated for fee-on-transfer tokens.
impact_direction.not_self_funded_or_dust_or_admin_or_timi: Pause bypass affects real custodied deposits; fee-on-transfer mismatch affects any such bridging user; not dust/self-funded/timing-only.

stop_condition: more_mechanisms_pending: pause bypass + fee-on-transfer mismatch carried; TSSAddressUpdater compromise unresolved
